title: RoadRestriction
description: One road restriction, including closures: road name, regulated section as a point, line or area, status and category.

@context.description: JSON-LD context of the entity, optional: a context URL or a list of context URLs

roadType.description: Road class by the Road Act (道路法第3条): expressway (高速自動車国道), nationalRoad (一般国道), prefecturalRoad (都道府県道), municipalRoad (市町村道), or other for a road outside the Act (農道, 林道, private road). A motorway designation (自動車専用道路) is not a class of its own: give the class of the road it is on

address.description: Address of the location, as a JapaneseAddress value (common subject)

location.description: The regulated section, as a GeoJSON geometry. A point for a single-spot restriction, a LineString for a section, a polygon for an area, matching the point/line/area regulation forms (点規制・線規制・面規制) of the NPA's traffic regulation data format (交通規制情報（拡張版標準フォーマット）説明書 Ver: k_2.1, JARTIC, 2025-01-20)

restrictionLength.description: Length of the regulated section in metres, for a line. The NPA format (距離・延長, item 133) and EEI (距離・延長) carry it; the geometry alone may be simplified

maximumAllowedWeight.description: Weight limit in kilograms: vehicles heavier than this may not pass (for example 4000 when the source limit is 4 t). The same term as Smart Data Models RoadSegment; the NPA format gives it in tonnes (制限重量, item 135). Whether it is gross weight or payload follows the source; keep its wording in statusLabel

restrictionStatus.description: Normalised restriction state, the value space of Smart Data Models RoadSegment.status: closed (no traffic), limited (traffic possible but not in full capacity), open (restriction lifted or not yet in place). The local wording goes in statusLabel; regulationCategory gives the finer public-sector category. When no value fits, leave it out and give the local wording in statusLabel

regulationCategory.description: Regulation category, from the legend of MLIT's Road Information Provision System (道路情報提供システム 通行規制情報, road-info-prvs.mlit.go.jp, accessed 2026-09-24): the categories a road administrator uses for a driver-facing closure or restriction. closedWeather (通行止(異常気象等)) also covers closures after a disaster, such as a landslide or a collapsed road shoulder. Optional and independent of restrictionStatus

statusLabel.description: The restriction status in the local or source system's wording (依頼中, 通行止め中, 解除済み). Required when restrictionStatus is left out
